# Trump and UFC 334: research brief

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-14: UFC 334 (branded "Polymarket UFC 334") is scheduled at Madison Square Garden, New York. The main card starts at 9:00 PM ET. The main event is Ciryl Gane (c) vs. Josh Hokit for the heavyweight title, and the co-main is Kayla Harrison (c) vs. Amanda Nunes. [UFC.com](https://www.ufc.com/event/ufc-334), [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UFC_334)
- The question resolves on whether Trump is physically at MSG before Nov 15 (NY time). In practice that means the night of Nov 14, which would be confirmed by press and pool reports. Neither the UFC page nor Wikipedia mentions Trump.

## 2. Current status
- 2026-10-25: Nothing settles the question yet. I found no announcement, White House schedule item, or Dana White statement saying Trump will or won't attend UFC 334.
- The event is still on track. Recent card changes (Yañez withdrawing, a cancelled lightweight bout) are minor. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UFC_334)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-24: Punch reports the two title fights at MSG on Nov 14 are confirmed. [Punch](https://punchng.com/ufc-334-sets-two-title-fights-for-new-york/)
- 2026-10-23: Alex Pereira picks Gane over Hokit. Trump isn't mentioned. [Bloody Elbow](https://bloodyelbow.com/2026/10/23/alex-pereira-makes-his-pick-for-ciryl-gane-vs-josh-hokit-at-ufc-334-unless-he-really-changes/)
- 2026-09-25: Trump confirmed he will go to China for APEC in Shenzhen. The leaders' meetings are Nov 18-19, four days after UFC 334, so the trip may affect his schedule that week. [Izvestia](https://en.iz.ru/en/2173662/2026-09-25/trump-confirms-his-visit-china-apec-summit), [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3368914/3-top-reasons-trump-will-face-stronger-xi-jinping-november-apec-forum-china)
- 2026-06-14: At UFC Freedom 250 on the White House South Lawn, Hokit beat Derrick Lewis by TKO, a fight Dana White said Trump helped put together. Hokit thanked Trump, gave him a medallion and made a widely criticized remark about Michelle Obama. Hokit therefore has a personal connection to Trump, which could add interest for Trump or political risk. [HITC](https://www.hitc.com/donald-trump-crowns-josh-hokit-his-top-ufc-pick-snubs-khabib-nurmagomedov/), [Fox 35](https://www.fox35orlando.com/news/ufc-boss-distances-himself-from-fighters-obama-remark-report)
- Midterm elections are Nov 3, 2026, 11 days before the event (general knowledge).

## 4. Base rates
Trump's in-person attendance at numbered and marquee UFC events:
- 2019-11: UFC 244 at MSG, attended (first sitting president at a UFC event). [Gulf News](https://gulfnews.com/amp/sport/donald-trump-to-attend-saturdays-ufc-244-at-madison-square-garden-1.67496039)
- 2023-11 (UFC 295 at MSG) and 2024-06 (UFC 302 in Newark): attended (my own background knowledge, not checked in this session).
- 2024-11-16: UFC 309 at MSG, attended with Musk. [CBS](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-madison-square-garden-ufc-event)
- 2025-04 (UFC 314 in Miami) and 2025-06-07 (UFC 316 in Newark): attended.
- 2025-11-15: UFC 322 at MSG, did **not** attend. Dana White confirmed he would skip it, in a week of Epstein email coverage and shortly after he was booed at a Commanders game. Sportsnaut said he "has not missed a show since 2022" at MSG. [Low Kick MMA](https://www.lowkickmma.com/donald-trump-will-not-be-in-attendance-for-ufc-322-among-ongoing-epstein-controversy/), [Sportsnaut](https://sportsnaut.com/ufc/trump-absence-ufc-322-explained)
- 2026-04-11: UFC 327 at the Kaseya Center in Miami, attended. [CBS12](https://cbs12.com/news/local/gallery-president-trump-takes-the-spotlight-at-ufc-327-in-miami-kaseya-center-miami-dana-white-joe-rogan-kid-rock-marco-rubio-sergio-gor-carlos-ulberg-light-heavyweight-title-paulo-costa-azamat-murzakanov-josh-hokit-curtis-blaydes)
- 2026-06-14: UFC Freedom 250 at the White House, hosted it. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/06/14/politics/live-news/ufc-fight-white-house)
- Summary: since taking office in Jan 2025 he has gone to roughly 4 of about 20 numbered PPVs plus the White House card. He goes much more often to MSG, Miami and Newark cards. At November MSG cards he is 3 for 4 (2019, 2023, 2024 yes; 2025 no). I found no record of him attending any UFC event from July to October 2026.

## 5. Other forecasts
Kalshi prices as of 2026-10-25 06:08 UTC:
- "Will Donald Trump attend UFC 334?" (Nov 14): **Yes 30%**. This matches the question.
- UFC 335 (Dec 12): Yes 7%.
- UFC 333 (Oct 24, Abu Dhabi): Yes 1%. The event has passed and he didn't attend, as expected.

I didn't find a Polymarket, Manifold or Metaculus market on this question. Polymarket sponsors the event but doesn't appear to list a Trump attendance market.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-03: Midterm elections. The results and his post-election mood or schedule could matter.
- Around Nov 9-13: fight week. In the past, Dana White has hinted at or confirmed Trump's attendance a few days ahead (he did both for UFC 322 and for Miami), so watch his media appearances and the White House weekly schedule.
- About Nov 16-17: Trump would likely leave for APEC in Shenzhen (Nov 18-19). A Saturday night in New York on Nov 14 is still possible, but the trip may compete for his time.
- Other possible factors: security posture at MSG, Hokit's political profile, any news cycle like the one before UFC 322, and possible Musk or cabinet attendance.
